records.key: Check the pages, adjust any box, then export the PDF.
records.source: Check the pages, adjust any box, then export the PDF.
records.translation: Kontrollera sidorna, justera eventuella rutor och exportera sedan PDF-filen.

records.key: Fields of each chosen well; tick the ones to export.
records.source: Fields of each chosen well; tick the ones to export.
records.translation: Bildfält i varje vald brunn; kryssa i dem som ska exporteras.

records.key: Place an image file from disk on the page.
records.source: Place an image file from disk on the page.
records.translation: Placera en bildfil från disk på sidan.

records.key: Edit the page after this one.
records.source: Edit the page after this one.

records.key: Edit the page before this one.
records.source: Edit the page before this one.

records.key: Close the export section; the settings section returns as it was.
records.source: Close the export section; the settings section returns as it was.
records.translation: Stäng exportsektionen; inställningssektionen återgår som den var.

records.key: Hide the export settings; the canvas keeps every change.
records.source: Hide the export settings; the canvas keeps every change.
records.translation: Dölj exportinställningarna; arbetsytan behåller varje ändring.
